A uniform metre rule is pivoted in equilibrium at the 50cm mark. A mass of 25g is placed at the
30cm mark on the rule.
What is the smallest mass that can be placed on the rule to restore equilibrium?
A
5g
B
10g
C
15g
D
25g
subject: Physics
